claims: JuJu Watkins suffered a torn ACL in her right knee during a March 2025 second-round NCAA Tournament game against Mississippi State.
JuJu Watkins went down on a fast break, clutching her right knee.
In September 2025, JuJu Watkins announced she would sit out the entire 2025-26 season to ensure a full recovery.
The injury caused JuJu Watkins to miss the entire 2025-26 season to focus on rehabilitation.
JuJu Watkins is targeting a return for the 2026-27 season, her senior season.
JuJu Watkins has been supporting the USC team from the sidelines while recovering.
JuJu Watkins has been undergoing intense daily rehab, including pool work to regain strength and function.
JuJu Watkins has remained part of the USC team despite her absence from play.
The USC team had to adjust for the 2025-26 season without JuJu Watkins' high-scoring presence.
